name: nature-paper-to-patent
description: Convert papers, theses, or research manuscripts into evidence-grounded Chinese invention patent drafts with claims, specification, abstract, and figures as separate DOCX files.

interface.shortDescription: Turn research papers into Chinese invention patent drafts.
defaultPrompt: Convert this paper into a Chinese invention patent draft
interface.longDescription: Extracts patentable technical contributions, maps every claimed feature to source evidence, preserves core formulas as editable Office Math, generates claim-aligned flowcharts, and delivers separate Chinese DOCX files for claims, specification, abstract, and abstract figure.
